standfirst: The type genus of the closterovirids: a replicase polyprotein and RdRp on a single long RNA, then the quintuple gene block — HSP70 homolog, HSP90 homolog, CPm, CP — followed by a species-specific accessory set named by mass.

modules.Closterovirus: The accessories are the interesting part. P13 is carried by only about a tenth of the genomes in this module, so it must NOT hold copy_num: a feature marked essential flags every genome that lacks it, and marking the accessories essential is what took this module to 0.0% clean once.

gaps: The unbound tail is large and honest. This page is reconstructed from the collections as shipped, so a string whose sequences matched a rule but were then dropped on length, ambiguity or a cleavage check counts as unbound.
